senses.gloss: f.(b. h. מַתְכּנֶֹת; תָּכַן)measure, required amount. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 9 שהיה שמם חקוק עליהם במ׳ הלבנים (the lists) in which their names were recorded with their daily task of bricks.
units: Yalk. Ex. 182 מַתְכּוֹנוֹת הלבנים pl.—
<cite ref="Keritot 6b:4">Ker. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>בכל יום היה מתקן במַתְכּוּנְתָּהּ</he> he might prepare every day the quantity of frankincense required for the occasion.
